capex.source: Purchases of property and equipment (cash flow statement; FY2025 10-K via marketscreener summary and Ex.99.1 0001628280-26-003832); excludes finance lease principal payments

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 22% (200,966 vs 164,501); decelerating fade on larger base as AI-driven ad growth normalises

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 41.4% (83,276/200,966), FY2024 42.2%; trimmed for rising depreciation and AI infrastructure/Reality Labs costs

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate normalised effective rate; FY2025 reported rate distorted by one-off tax items (net income 60,458 vs EBIT 83,276 + 2,656 other income)

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 9.3% (18,616/200,966) rising as heavy 2025-26 capex depreciates

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 34.7% (69,691/200,966); management guided 2026 capex well above 2025, so held elevated; blended average over five years with fade toward terminal

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM ~4.3% risk-free + beta ~1.2 x 4.5-5% ERP, minimal debt weight; ~9%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP growth, below WACC

net_debt.source: Long-term debt 58,744 (excl. leases) minus cash, equivalents and marketable securities 81,590 (reported $81.59bn) at 12/31/2025, Ex.99.1 acc. 0001628280-26-003832

diluted_shares.source: Weighted-average diluted shares FY2025 (millions), per stockanalysis.com; consistent with net income 60,458 / diluted EPS 23.49
